Jacobian Matrix for Latent Models

Source: R/jacobian_latent.R
jacobian.latent.Rd

jacobian.latent() evaluates the derivatives of transformed parameters at the fitted parameter estimates. The Jacobian is used by latent to propagate covariance matrices through parameter transformations using the delta method.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'latent'
jacobian(fit, parameters = NULL)

Arguments

fit

A fitted object inheriting from class "latent".

parameters

Optional parameter specification identifying the transformed parameters for which derivatives should be returned. Parameter labels must occur in fit@modelInfo$transparameters_labels. If NULL, the parameter blocks corresponding to the fitted model parameters are used.

Value

A numeric matrix containing the Jacobian for the selected parameters. Row and column names correspond to transformed-parameter labels.

Details

Compute the Jacobian matrix associated with parameter transformations in a fitted latent variable model.

Only transformations required to obtain the selected parameters are evaluated. Dependencies between transformations are identified recursively, so parameters obtained through several successive transformations are supported.

The same Jacobian machinery is used by vcov.latent to apply the delta method to transformed parameters.

See also

jacobian, hessian.latent, vcov.latent, constraints_derivs.latent
